captions.text: The page looks finished. The hero arrives late.
The first click sits there. Two complaints, one word: slow.
Loading: how soon is the largest element painted?
Interaction: how soon does the page respond after you act?
A 4000 px lossless PNG, over 12 MB, for a 1600 px slot.
The largest element cannot paint until the bytes arrive and decode.
The handler compares 20,000 items against every other, synchronously.
Node CPU time, median of 7 runs: 4253 ms. Not browser INP.
Same picture, 1600×900 WebP: 17,004 bytes instead of 12,173,721.
Still above the fold, still not lazy-loaded.
Count each collection once, then look it up. Identical digest.
Node CPU median: 1.40 ms. Removed, not hidden.
Measured here: file bytes; handler CPU time in Node, 7 runs, median.
Not measured: LCP and Event Timing. No browser lab was available.
Loading quickly and responding quickly are different tests.
Run both, under the same conditions.
